newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton buyers sidelined.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton buyers sidelined.

text.p: Many raw cotton buyers in Europe were sidelined by the failure of New York cotton futures to weaken following a higher forecast for the prospective U.S. output from Washington, industry sources said.
The main items attracting attention in Europe remained the higher grade cottons of Central Asian origin, and attractively priced good quality styles from the Mediterranean.

Overall volume was low, with buyers in Europe expected to continue closely watching developments on the New York futures before adding substantially to their purchasing commitments. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 8074
